description: State compatibility of published Praxis releases (PRX-QUAL-010). The self-hosting pin in .echelon/toolchain.json must name a release listed here whose `reads` cover every state-schema version the repository's committed state declares, or the gap must be an owned, unexpired exception. Releases from 3.8.0 on declare the same table in their release.json; earlier entries were recorded from the source at their tag (the versions their readers accept and their state wrote). praxis-remote-enable.sh adds a release here when it pins it, after verifying the release's checksums and build-provenance attestation. Enforced by tests/Praxis.Tests/PremergeReleaseTests.fs.
